name: HeightLe.nonneg
summary: Let H witness HeightLe c 1. H is algebraic (bounded at all 2-adic isomorphisms), so q = N_{ℚ(H)/ℚ}(H) is a nonzero rational. At every place, archimedean or ℓ-adic, the bound on the conjugates of H bounds log|q|/deg from above by α resp. e(ℓ); summing over ℓ < M and using c ≥ α + Σ e(ℓ), the product formula for q gives c ≥ 0.

steps.claim: Unfold HeightLe c 1 (with H·1 = H): obtain H ∈ ℂ with H ≠ 0, a real α with |σ(H)| ≤ exp α for every automorphism σ of ℂ (d), a function e : ℕ → ℝ with ‖ι(H)‖_ℓ ≤ exp e(ℓ) for every (ℓ, ι) (f), and a threshold M₀ such that α + Σ_{ℓ<M, ℓ prime} e(ℓ) ≤ c for every M ≥ M₀ (g).
steps.lean: choose H _ _ d _ f _ g using by simpa [HeightLe] using h

steps.claim: H is algebraic over ℚ: by f at the prime 2 (the default element of Nat.Primes), ‖ι(H)‖ ≤ exp e(2) for every isomorphism ι : ℂ → ℚ̄_2, which is the hypothesis of isAlgebraic_of_padic. Hence ℚ(H) is finite-dimensional over ℚ, i.e. a number field.

Lemma k: for every algebraically closed normed field F of characteristic 0 with #ℂ = #F (e) and every real number c (a local variable, not the c of the statement) such that ‖ι(H)‖ ≤ exp c for every ring isomorphism ι : ℂ → F (h): log‖N(H)‖_F / [ℚ(H) : ℚ] ≤ c, where N(H) ∈ ℚ is the norm of H from ℚ(H) to ℚ, mapped into F.
steps.lean:
have k {F c} [NormedField F] [CharZero F] [IsAlgClosed F] (e : _ = _) (h : ∀ ι : _ ≃+* F, ‖ι H‖ ≤
      exp c) := show ‖algebraMap ℚ F (Algebra.norm ℚ (gen ℚ H))‖.log / finrank ℚ ℚ⟮H⟯ ≤ c by grw [
    Algebra.norm_eq_prod_embeddings, norm_prod, prod_le_prod₀ _ fun σ _ ↦
    (exists_ringEquiv_extend e ℚ⟮H⟯.val
    σ.1).choose_spec ⟨H, _⟩ ▸ h _] <;> simp_all [finrank_pos.ne', prod_pos, Subtype.ext_iff]

steps.claim: The image of N(H) in F is the product of σ(H) over the [ℚ(H):ℚ] embeddings σ : ℚ(H) → F; each σ extends to an isomorphism ℂ → F (exists_ringEquiv_extend, using #ℂ = #F), so ‖σ(H)‖ ≤ exp c and ‖N(H)‖_F ≤ (exp c)^{[ℚ(H):ℚ]}. As H ≠ 0 every factor is nonzero, so the logarithm is monotone here; dividing by the positive degree gives the claim.
steps.lean:
show ‖algebraMap ℚ F (Algebra.norm ℚ (gen ℚ H))‖.log / finrank ℚ ℚ⟮H⟯ ≤ c by grw [
    Algebra.norm_eq_prod_embeddings, norm_prod, prod_le_prod₀ _ fun σ _ ↦
    (exists_ringEquiv_extend e ℚ⟮H⟯.val
    σ.1).choose_spec ⟨H, _⟩ ▸ h _] <;> simp_all [finrank_pos.ne', prod_pos, Subtype.ext_iff]
steps.typed_fact: ‖algebraMap ℚ F (Algebra.norm ℚ (gen ℚ H))‖.log / finrank ℚ ℚ⟮H⟯ ≤ c

steps.claim: Bound c from below. For M = M₀ + M' (M' still free) g gives c ≥ α + Σ_{ℓ<M prime} e(ℓ). By k with F = ℂ (the cardinality condition is trivial) and d, α ≥ log|N(H)|/deg; by k with F = ℚ̄_ℓ (#ℂ = #ℚ̄_ℓ by mk_complex_eq_mk_padicAlgCl) and f at ℓ, e(ℓ) ≥ log|N(H)|_ℓ/deg for each prime ℓ < M, where the norm of ℚ̄_ℓ restricted to ℚ is the ℓ-adic absolute value. So it suffices to show 0 ≤ log|N(H)|/deg + Σ_{ℓ<M prime} log|N(H)|_ℓ/deg.

The right side is (log|q| + Σ_{p<M prime} log|q|_p)/deg for the rational q = N(H). Choosing M' so that M = M₀ + M' exceeds max(|num q|, den q), the product formula log_product_formula makes the numerator 0; so the right side is 0/deg = 0 and the inequality 0 ≤ 0 holds.
